Guidance: The operational deliverable, documentation, system asset, credentials, warranty, or support agreement formally transferred to the sustaining operations team.
The operational team, service owner, or designated role accepting ongoing responsibility and stewardship for the item.
The specific operational readiness criteria and verification evidence required before formal handover sign-off.
The scheduled or actual date on which ownership and support accountability are formally transferred.
The formal verification status (e.g., Accepted, Conditional, Pending) confirming operational readiness.
